### Checklist
- [ ] The plugin installs in Nookdeck from its GitHub URL (Manage, Plugins, install box).
- [ ] `nookdeck.json` declares only the permissions it needs, and the entry here matches it.
- [ ] `sha256` is the value shown on the plugin's card in the manage page after install.
- [ ] Entries stay sorted by `id`; I did not set `verified`.
- [ ] A screenshot shows demo data only, no personal data.
- [ ] I maintain this plugin and will open a PR here for each new version.
